# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6, shared main-line lock; 2026-11-19 round 7 F1, the main-line scheduler. Generated by gen_mainline_lock.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Take this calendar month for a main-line event. The first taker of a month is recorded in oe_ml_by: the
# line the scheduler is running (oe_ml_cur), or 99 outside the monthly round (a delayed follow-up, a test button).
oe_ml_take = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ml_cur } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ml_by value = global_var:oe_ml_cur } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ml_by value = 99 } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ml_month value = oe_ml_month_now }
}
# Any scope. The same, naming the taker: line = an id of the scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES).
oe_ml_take_as = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ml_by value = $line$ } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ml_month value = oe_ml_month_now }
}

# Any scope. Marks once whether this game began at the 1337 start (global oe_start_1337: 1 yes, 0 no). Called at game
# start and, as a net, at the top of every monthly pulse. A game that already has the scheduler's record (oe_ml_ran)
# but no mark is a save from before the mark existed: every such game was a 1337 game. Otherwise the date decides
# (the first pulse of a 1337 game is still in 1337).
oe_ml_mark_start = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_start_1337 } }
        if = { limit = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ml_ran current_year < 1338 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_start_1337 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_start_1337 value = 0 } }
    }
}
